description: Isolated bar-based TA core. Subscribes to EVT:BAR_CLOSED, computes 18 technical indicators on every configured bar, and emits EVT:TA_FEATURES_CALCULATED with explicit readiness semantics instead of dropping pre-warmup state.

imports.description: Canonical OHLCV bar close events from BarAggregator.

exports.description: Flat TA payload with explicit warmup state for consumers that want separate TA provenance.

components.name: ta_features.py
components.role: Runtime FSM handler that buffers bars, computes TA features, emits EVT:TA_FEATURES_CALCULATED, and writes JSONL diagnostics.

components.name: calculators.py
components.role: Pure TA math helpers and neutral fallbacks for insufficient history.

components.name: contracts.py
components.role: Shared TA event constants and feature-vector extraction helpers for downstream consumers.

side_effects.description: Per-symbol JSONL log of each TA calculation (rotating according to config.domains.ta_features log settings).

ssot_notes.warmup_semantics: EVT:TA_FEATURES_CALCULATED is emitted for every configured bar. Consumers must read is_warm together with warm_up_bars and required_warm_up_bars instead of inferring readiness from missing events.
ssot_notes.coexistence: ta_features is a separate TA event plane. feature_engineering remains its own contract and ta_features does not co-emit into EVT:FEATURES_CALCULATED.
ssot_notes.hidden_config_policy: config/ta_features.yaml is retired. No side-loaded ta_features config is allowed.
